messages:
Sam (AE): quick heads-up — RiverBank wants a proposal for a 6mo pilot + option to convert to annual. They asked for 30% off list and zero onboarding fee. timeline: need signed PO by EOW or they'll move to competitor.
Priya (RevOps): rough numbers? have we modeled margin + CAC for that ask?
Sam (AE): current list for this config (private VPC, reserved 2xA100 equivalent, managed support): $120k/mo. Their ask = 30% -> $84k/mo. They also want 90 days of waived setup.
Jorge (Security): also flag: they submitted expanded security questionnaire (SOC/iso + egress controls). Legal/sec review might add 2–3 days. If we waive onboarding, ensure we have clear SOW limits.
Emma (Eng): capacity wise dedicated pool is fine, but 2xA100 reserved for a new private tenant needs lead time. Can we offer a short ramp (start with shared host + private data plane) to accelerate?
Sam (AE): thinking of two proposal options to present tomorrow:
```
Option A: 25% off for 6mo, setup fee waived, convert to 12mo at +10% price (no additional discount) if they convert within 60 days after pilot. Includes 24/7 premium support.
Option B: 15% off for 12mo committed, $25k onboarding credit, and 6 months of compute-offset credits (credits = pre-purchased burst capacity usable for spikes).
```
Priya (RevOps): finance floor = 20% for a 6mo pilot without a committed conversion. Anything below 20% needs deal desk sign-off. A 25% pilot that converts makes the effective LTV higher — ok as long as we get conversion clause and PO deadline in agreement.
Sam (AE): we can add a conversion credit: if they convert within 45d -> credit equal to 50% of pilot months applied to first invoice. That helps margin after conversion.
Jorge (Security): must attach conditional clause: onboarding waiver contingent on receiving completed security attestation and network allowlist. No exceptions for data retention or audit log access.
LegalBot: auto-scan: proposed conversion clause language flagged for ambiguity on "applied to first invoice" — recommend specify "applied as dollar credit to first invoice after conversion" and cap credit at X.
Priya (RevOps): decision required: approve 25% pilot (with conversion credit & 45d conversion window) OR counter with 20% + onboarding credit. Which do we want to escalate?
Emma (Eng): tech ops note — if we promise waived setup we should not promise same-day cutover. Recommend wording: "no setup fee; standard onboarding work to be scheduled within 5 business days." Keeps promise but realistic.
Sam (AE): customer pressure is real — they want procurement card on file and fast cutover. If we push 20% they'll likely walk. Suggest asking Deal Desk for a one-off 25% pilot escape clause that requires PO by Friday and sec attestation within 14 days.
Priya (RevOps): ok I can approve a one-time 25% pilot discount if these 3 conditions are met: 1) PO by end of day Friday (ts: 3751234999) 2) signed conversion intent showing committed 12mo at list price if conversion executed after pilot or an agreed conversion delta, 3) security attestation submitted within 14 days. If any of those fail, price reverts and outstanding credits are void.
Sam (AE): perfect — I'll update the offer and call RiverBank. I'll include the exact clause per LegalBot recommendation. :thumbsup:
Jorge (Security): I'll prioritize the questionnaire review — ping me when they upload.
Emma (Eng): I'll prepare a short runbook for the accelerated onboarding path and estimate 72h baseline prep if we start on shared host.
Sam (AE): thanks team. I'll post the final term sheet here once updated.
Sam (AE): (later) sent draft to RiverBank — they asked if we could reflect the compute-offset credits as a line item. I posted this snippet: 
`Compute-offset credits: 250k tokens of burst capacity per month, usable across the account; expires after pilot; non-refundable.`
Priya (RevOps): that wording ok but add explicit dollar equivalent for invoice clarity. e.g., `Compute-offset credits (dollar equivalent $12,500/mo)`
RiverBank (external): (via email forwarded) thanks — procurement will try to get PO by Friday. Security upload scheduled for tomorrow.
Sam (AE): closing loop — RiverBank indicated PO is likely but not guaranteed. Priya — want me to escalate to deal desk now or wait till we have uploaded sec attestation?
Priya (RevOps): escalate now with conditional approval. I'll add the margin guardrails in the ticket and note conversion credit details.
LegalBot: contract template updated with clarified conversion credit language and onboarding scheduling clause.
Sam (AE): appreciate it all. If procurement drops PO, I'll drop a final note here. :crossed_fingers:
